sentences.l1: Coffee is a kind of drink.
Many people like drinking coffee.

sentences.l2: 咖啡豆是做咖啡的材料。
sentences.l1: Coffee beans are the material for making coffee.
Coffee beans grow on trees.
The people on the farm grow coffee trees.
Coffee trees bear fruit.
There are coffee beans in the fruit.
Coffee beans have to be dried in the sun.

sentences.l2: 然后，咖啡豆被装进大袋子。
sentences.l1: Then, the coffee beans are packed into big bags.

sentences.l2: 大船把咖啡豆运到别的国家。
sentences.l1: Big ships carry the coffee beans to other countries.
This is exporting.

sentences.l2: 别的国家买咖啡豆，这是进口。
sentences.l1: Other countries buy the coffee beans, and this is importing.

sentences.l2: 工厂把咖啡豆做成咖啡。
sentences.l1: Factories turn the coffee beans into coffee.
People buy coffee to drink in shops.
This is consumption.

sentences.l2: 咖啡从农场到杯子，要经过很多地方。
sentences.l1: Coffee goes from the farm to the cup, passing through many places.
This process is called trade.
Agriculture helps produce coffee beans.
Without farmers, there would be no coffee.

sentences.l2: 我们喝的咖啡，来自世界各地的农场。
sentences.l1: The coffee we drink comes from farms all over the world.
